rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when information or a fact is not known or clear.

example.english: This matter is still unknown to me.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 zung6 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this specifically when a person, place, or thing is not well known or famous.

example.english: That restaurant was still unknown back then.
example.traditional: 嗰間餐廳以前仲唔出名。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ji5 cin4 zung6 m4 ceot1 meng2

rows.note: Use this when an unidentified person or thing has an unknown identity.

example.english: The police found a body of unknown identity.
example.traditional: 警方發現一具身份不明嘅屍體。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 faat3 jin6 jat1 geoi6 san1 fan6 bat1 ming4 ge3 si1 tai2

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written contexts for something whose outcome or details are not known.

example.jyutping: git3 gwo2 jing4 jin4 mei6 zi1
